Text: The review concludes intervention X is effective, discussing three positive trials in detail while dismissing the one large null trial as methodologically weak.
Why Not Neighbors: Primary error is asymmetric treatment of support versus contradiction, not mere loaded wording.

Text: Overall, the weight of evidence supports supplementation, with inconsistent findings receiving little further discussion.
Why Not Neighbors: One-sided evidence integration is the issue, not certainty alone.

Text: Taken together, the included studies definitively demonstrate that telemonitoring improves outcomes in heart failure.
Why Not Neighbors: The main problem is overconfident synthesis language, not a causal-vs-associational structure call.

Text: This review proves that mindfulness is effective for reducing burnout among clinicians.
Why Not Neighbors: The statement is too definitive for a review summary; it does not chiefly widen scope.

Text: Although most included studies were conducted in tertiary hospitals in Europe, these findings apply to all healthcare settings worldwide.
Why Not Neighbors: Primary error is scope expansion beyond studied settings, not just strong wording.

Text: Evidence from adult outpatient samples indicates the intervention works for all age groups.
Why Not Neighbors: The key failure is population broadening; certainty is secondary.

Text: The intervention reduced complications by 60%, making it a compelling option for routine care.
Why Not Neighbors: The framing centers a relative gain without baseline context; no evidence is omitted in the sentence itself.

Text: Only 4% of patients failed treatment across the included studies, indicating the therapy performs strongly.
Why Not Neighbors: This is loss-framed packaging of the same result, not confirmation bias.

Text: Across the included cohort studies, screen time causes anxiety in adolescents.
Why Not Neighbors: The central problem is causal language from non-causal evidence, not certainty alone.

Text: The review shows that chronic inflammation drives depressive symptoms.
Why Not Neighbors: Directional mechanism is asserted without clear causal warrant.
